name: rubiks-cube-improver
description: Timer, scramble generator and algorithm trainer for speedcubing. Runs on Windows and the web.

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:store: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win appx
